I am z3itt, an independent developer and student from Turkey. You can take a look at my GitHub or my website to know me a little better, or to see my other projects. You can reach me on Discord too. Thank you so much for using my app. I hope it has been useful for you.
Why did I make this app?

This is my first Android app project. A while ago, someone in my friends\' Discord server sent a picture of the Feelings Wheel. It inspired me so much in that moment that I noted it on my phone. I thought it had the potential to become an app and help people who need support with their emotions (this includes me too; you could call it \"self-insertion in the creation\"). So I started the project, and this is the outcome. My biggest goal was to require as few decisions as possible, so the app would not overwhelm users. So that\'s it.
Thank you for using my app.

Last updated: August 2026

FeelS helps you log emotions on your device. This policy explains what we collect and how we use it.

What we collect
• Emotion check-ins (feeling, intensity, optional notes)
• App preferences (reminder times, disclaimer acceptance)

All of this stays on your device. FeelS does not send your check-ins or notes to our servers. We do not sell your data.

Storage and security
• Data is stored locally in an encrypted database on your phone.
• Clearing history in the app permanently deletes check-ins from this device.

Notifications
• If enabled, reminders are scheduled on your device only.
• You can export or import check-ins as a JSON file you choose. FeelS does not upload that file.

Children
• FeelS is not directed at children under 13.

Changes
• We may update this policy. The in-app text will reflect the latest version.

Contact
• For privacy questions, contact info@z3itt.com

By using FeelS, you agree to these terms.

What FeelS is
• FeelS is a personal emotion check-in tool for reflection and self-awareness.
• It is not medical care, therapy, diagnosis, or crisis support.

Your responsibility
• Do not use FeelS as a substitute for professional help.
• If you are in crisis or may harm yourself or others, contact local emergency services or a qualified professional immediately.

Your data
• You own the content you enter. You can delete all history from the app menu at any time.
• You are responsible for keeping your device secure.

Acceptable use
• Use FeelS lawfully. The app is licensed under the GNU GPL v3, including the right to share and modify the source.

Disclaimer
• FeelS is provided "as is" without warranties. We are not liable for decisions you make based on the app.

Changes
• We may update these terms. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.

FeelS is free software licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.

Contact
• Questions about these terms can be sent to info@z3itt.com
